name: Omen of the Hunt
description:
While this item is active in your inventory the next
Possessed monster you kill will release its Azmeri Spirit
directions: Right click this item in your inventory to set it to be active. This item is consumed when triggered. Only one Omen can be triggered from combat in each instance.
consoleDirections: Press Xin your inventory to set it to be active. This item is consumed when triggered. Only one Omen can be triggered from combat in each instance.
